description: This PHP class file defines the EmployeeSalaryModel class, which models employee salary data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It uses PHP traits and annotations for serialization, and maps to the EmployeeSalary entity. The class specifies which attributes and related properties are exposed for API responses, including salary details and direct debit information.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryModel
classes.description: A model representing employee salary data for API serialization, including properties such as id, amount, salary name, comments, pay period, pay grade, currency type, and direct debit information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSalaryModel by setting the entity and defining filters and attribute names for serialization.
